how_to: فایل را به مترجم بده؛ خروجی را با نام fa-out-quest-unknown-10.json برگردان.
rules: به فارسی روان و معنادار ترجمه کن، نه آوانگاری؛ فقط نام خاص شخص/مکان آوانگاری می‌شود. هر ⟦...⟧ را دقیقاً همان‌طور و به تعداد اصلی نگه دار (جابه‌جایی در جمله مجاز است). عددها را حفظ کن (ارقام فارسی یا لاتین فرقی ندارد). ی و ک فارسی، نیم‌فاصله در «می‌»، «ها» و «ای». هیچ حرف لاتین در خروجی نباشد مگر داخل ⟦...⟧. از glossary برای واژه‌ها پیروی کن. خروجی فقط JSON: {"pack": <همین pack>, "fa": {"<کلید>": "ترجمه"}} با همهٔ کلیدهای rows، نه کم نه زیاد.
tokens_note: ⟦عدد⟧ = کد بازی (نام بازیکن، خط جدید، رنگ). ⟦E..⟧ = نام مصوب؛ معنی‌اش در entities است. هر دو را دست‌نخورده نگه دار.

rows.quest:65601:details:0:
A sayaad male is known as an incubus. A creature of profound evil and singular mind.

The ⟦E26⟧ must be lured into our world with an item of enticement - an object that represents great love and devotion.

If you trust a blind man to lead you, ⟦70⟧ , then listen. East from the Cleft of ⟦E27⟧, along the main drag of ⟦E25⟧, lives Magar. He longs for the return of his mate, Krilge.

Seek him out. He'll ask you to search for something precious. That is the key which you must bring to Gan'rul.
rows.quest:65601:completion:0: Who told you about Krilge? Have you come with any news? You better not be toying with me...
rows.quest:65602:title: What Is Love?
rows.quest:65602:details:0:
You will need a powerful reagent to tempt an incubus -- an object that represents great devotion and love.

With my scrying, I have located a small figurine that should be suitable for your ritual.

Thousands of years ago, the figurine belonged to a young couple. The original owners are no more, but their keepsake has survived to the present day.

Follow the road north into ⟦E28⟧, then west and past Maestra's Post. You will see a house nestled amongst the trees. There you will find what you seek.
rows.quest:65602:completion:0: <Gakin turns the wooden figurine over in his hand.> ⟦71⟧ I sense the emotional energy residing within this artifact, undiminished by the passing of time. The incubus will be drawn to it like a fly to honey. ⟦72⟧ Takar never disappoints.
